title: Bangumi Relations And Episode Depth
problem: Bangumi metadata is subject-oriented, but the current adapter advertises season and episode support before it uses Bangumi relation or episode endpoints.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata bangumi_provider metadata_candidate --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened the Bangumi relation and episode depth lane from MPDP and TSEG closeout evidence.
Bangumi capabilities now advertise only endpoint-backed subject-level Movie, Series, and Unknown behavior; Season and Episode search/fetch requests fail before touching provider HTTP.

Bangumi series fetch now reads endpoint-backed episode summaries and projects main episodes into Candidate Graph related Episode nodes and contains relationships without changing persistence semantics.
